slate-canvas.$description: Slate Canvas — Primary page background, hero canvas, card surface base — the workspace floor everything sits on

ink-well.$description: Ink Well — Deepest surface — code block backgrounds, terminal panes, inset containers that need to feel recessed below the canvas

graphite-hairline.$description: Graphite Hairline — Subtle borders, divider lines, card edges — barely visible separators that let density carry the visual structure

steel-border.$description: Steel Border — Slightly darker hairline for nested containers and secondary borders where Graphite feels too bright

ash-text.$description: Ash Text — Tertiary text, captions, muted helper copy — text that should be readable but not competing with headlines

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Secondary body text, metadata, icon strokes — the most-used neutral text color, reading as a soft graphite on slate

cloud-text.$description: Cloud Text — Secondary headings, button text, emphasized body — one step below full white, used where pure white would feel harsh

bone-text.$description: Bone Text — Primary text, headlines, high-contrast labels — the dominant foreground color against the slate canvas

signal-lime.$description: Signal Lime — Green supporting accent for decorative details, logo mark, and primary CTA fill

syntax-violet.$description: Syntax Violet — Code syntax highlighting (functions, keywords), media generation feature icon

syntax-pink.$description: Syntax Pink — Code syntax (strings, special tokens), media processing feature icon

event-violet.$description: Event Violet — Headline highlight words, streaming feature icon, decorative gradient accent

loop-green.$description: Loop Green — Code syntax (types, booleans), inline emphasis text

tag-magenta.$description: Tag Magenta — Code syntax (property names, tags)

mute-red.$description: Mute Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

satoshi.$description: Display and heading — Satoshi carries every headline from 16px sub-labels up to the 60px hero
